motion.name: control-color
motion.purpose: Background, text and border color transitions; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Call, answer or register when available.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;line-height:1.45;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:42px;padding:10px 16px;border:0;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#b7ebd2}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){background:#83cba7}.ds-primary:disabled{background:#30383a;color:#a3b1ad;cursor:default}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Return from an empty state to the keypad.
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;line-height:1.45;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:42px;padding:10px 16px;border:0;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;min-height:36px;font-size:12px;background:var(--surface-raised);color:#e2e7ec;border:1px solid #444c56}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--surface-hover)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition:none!important}}

components.name: End call action
components.description: The supported hangup or reject action.
components.css: .ds-danger{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;line-height:1.45;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:42px;padding:10px 16px;border:0;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;background:#5e2e34;color:#ffd8dc}.ds-danger:hover:not(:disabled){background:#773943}.ds-danger:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:default}.ds-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Icon action
components.description: Compact back or settings-style header action.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="Zurück"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;line-height:1.45;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease;width:34px;height:34px;padding:7px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted);border-radius:7px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.ds-icon:hover{color:#f0f1f3;background:var(--surface-hover)}.ds-icon:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Settings field
components.description: Labeled raised field for SIP account settings.
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:550;color:#d5dae0;margin:0 0 5px}.ds-input{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;line-height:1.45;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease;cursor:text;width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:36px;padding:7px 10px;color:#f0f1f3;background:var(--surface-raised);border:1px solid #444c56;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Bottom navigation
components.description: Three labeled destinations with a selected page.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px;padding:7px 12px 9px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface)}.ds-tab{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;line-height:1.45;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease;display:grid;justify-items:center;align-content:center;gap:3px;min-height:46px;padding:5px 8px;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:8px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.ds-tab:hover{color:#f0f1f3;background:var(--surface-raised)}.ds-tab[aria-current]{background:#303c37;color:#b9e4cf}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Dial key
components.description: Number-entry key with a letter annotation.
components.css: .ds-key{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;line-height:1.45;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease,color 140ms ease,border-color 140ms ease;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;background:var(--surface-raised);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:9px;color:#f0f1f3;padding:3px;user-select:none;touch-action:manipulation}.ds-key:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--surface-hover);border-color:#46505b}.ds-key:active:not(:disabled){background:#3d4943}.ds-key:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px}.ds-digit{font-size:24px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:450}.ds-letters{font-size:10px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#bec5ce;margin-top:2px} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[class^="ds-"]{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Inline availability note
components.description: Raised informational container used in account settings.
components.html: Die Vorschau zeigt das Layout. Anmelden und telefonieren kannst du in der Desktop-App.

narrative.overview:
A compact, dark softphone shaped around the familiar telephone keypad. Charcoal surfaces, system typography and a restrained mint accent keep the number, registration state and available call action easy to scan in a small desktop window.

The system uses tonal layers and fine dividers rather than ornamental depth. German labels accompany the navigation and call actions; settings stay behind their own action, while the current call remains reachable when another view is open.
keyCharacteristics: Compact keypad and persistent three-item bottom navigation.
System typography with larger numbers and quiet supporting labels.
Charcoal tonal layers with mint for primary actions and available state.
Explicit empty and unavailable states grounded in actual capabilities.

rules.name: The State Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Use accent and danger color to identify available actions, selection and real runtime state.

dos: Do keep dialing and the current call action prominent in the compact window.
Do use German text labels alongside navigation icons and call actions.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do show real runtime availability and honest empty states.
donts: Don't turn contacts or history into populated lists before their data exists.
Don't add unsupported call controls such as mute, hold or transfer.
Don't replace native window controls with a decorative custom title bar.
Don't expand the compact utility into a dashboard layout.
